provenance: policy_v1.json remains frozen and unmodified; this record versions the pre-activation corrections without rewriting the original contract.

corrections.description: an age of exactly zero minutes is fresh; a missing/None age is not fresh
a bar timestamp in the future (negative age) is rejected, never treated as fresh
live underlying and live option freshness gate is approximately 2 minutes
delayed provider sources (Massive daily close) are ineligible for VERY_HIGH; no silent fallback
the proposal action must be compatible with the position direction (LONG/SHORT)
only partial_reduce and close may auto-execute under AUTO_IF_VERY_HIGH_PAPER
fill prices must be finite and strictly positive
fill quantities must be positive integers
option contract notional applies the 100-share-per-contract multiplier
a roll reports a signed net (credit positive, debit negative) across both legs
exactly one GLOBAL kill switch row per experiment
due-proposal processing only considers proposals whose mode permits auto-execution
concurrent runners atomically claim a due proposal before revalidation
